messages:
ana: Quick coordination: I'm drafting alert tuning for the GPU pools after last week's memory spike. Where's the canonical Grafana for SM% / memory / KV cache hit/eviction across pools? Need links + dashboard owners. TL;DR: proposing adjusted alerts (kvcache evict rate, p95 smem, batchsize regressions).
sam: use this dashboard — https://grafana.internal.redwood/g/dGPU/serving-overview (it's the pools view). Owners listed in the top-right panel dropdown.
jonah: pinging @ops_sre — we should have owners for each panel, last owner list is a month old.
ops_sre: noted. i own the canary/pool panels, lee owns the production pool panels. can you paste the exact alert thresholds you're proposing?
ana: (typo, ignore)
ana deleted a message
ana: sorry, meant ana ^
ana: :sweat_smile:
ana: proposed: 1) kvcache eviction rate > 5% over 5m for any pool -> P2 page; 2) GPU shared memory (smem) p95 > 85% for 3m -> P2; 3) sustained batch size drop (median per-minute) below expected by >20% for 10m -> warn.
lee: 5% eviction seems aggressive for small pools — might noise on short-lived spikes. Could we gate by requests volume (e.g., >5000 reqs/5m) to avoid flapping?
ana: good call. updated idea: eviction alert if eviction_rate_pct > 5 AND request_rate > 5k (5m).
sam: also add a suppression window for deploy canaries (we see evictions during canary warms). deploy-bot usually posts a tag; we can exclude by label.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: gpu-runtime/canary v1.29 started by @ci-pipeline — suppress-alerts=true
jonah: here's a quick PromQL for eviction pct by pool: 
```
100 * sum by(pool)(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) / sum by(pool)(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
jonah: and smem p95 by pool: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, pool)(rate(gpu_smem_usage_bytes_bucket[5m]))) / gpu_memory_total_bytes * 100
```
maya: I'll draft the alert-rules PR with those queries + the request_rate gate and suppression until we verify on staging. assigning to @maya for PR, will cc @lee and @ops_sre.
maya: for the batch size regression metric, we use `observability.batch.median_per_minute` derived from traces — I can surface it to grafana if we want a panel first.
lee: please add a short-runbook blurb in the PR about quick mitigations: shift traffic, bump cache size, restart worker group.
ops_sre: agreed. also include note to check kvcache hit-rate and eviction origins (memory pressure vs TTL).
ana: thanks all. maya, can you link the PR here once ready? If anyone wants to jump on a quick async review, ping me.
maya: will do, aiming to open PR in ~2 hours. tagging: @sam @jonah @ops_sre.
sam: quick aside — monitoring shows a recurring nightly spike in smem at ~03:10 UTC for pool-prod-a. Someone owns that pipeline?
lee: that's the ml-eval batch jobs hitting prod pool during maintenance slot — we need to move them to a dedicated batch pool. I'll raise a ticket with infra.
ana: can we also add a Grafana alert panel link directly in the PR so reviewers can eyeball current graphs? makes reviews faster.
maya: yep will include the dashboard link + example query snippets.
ops_sre: once PR is merged please run a dry-run in staging and we'll watch for flapping over 24h before promoting to prod.
ana: copy. thanks everyone.
sam: last nit — let's avoid creating too many severity-3 alerts. keep P1/P2 only when there's user impact.
ana: agreed. i'll mark the eviction rule P2, smem p95 as P1 if it correlates with higher latency in the same window.
lee: FYI I'll also add an annotation to the prod panels for the maintenance job schedule so it's easier to correlate.
maya: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/alerts/pull/412 (draft) — included queries, gating, and runbook stubs. reviewers: @ana (typo fixed), @lee, @ops_sre.
ana: opening quick CR pass now. thanks.:thumbsup: 
ops_sre: thanks team — will monitor after staging run.
ana: done for now.
